<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<title>Laughing yellow character</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:216px;height:216px;overflow:hidden;background:#f5f6f3}
canvas{display:block;width:216px;height:216px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xf5f6f3);

const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216,216);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure=0.96;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.2,2.2,2.2,-2.2,0.1,60);
ref.position.set(-0.28,2.70,9);
ref.lookAt(-0.28,2.28,0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffff7,0xb1a38b,1.6));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff8e9,2.45);
key.position.set(-3.6,7,5.5);
key.target.position.set(0,2,0);
key.castShadow=true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);
Object.assign(key.shadow.camera,{left:-4,right:4,top:5,bottom:-3,near:0.1,far:18});
key.shadow.normalBias=0.025;
key.shadow.bias=-0.00015;
key.shadow.radius=3;
scene.add(key,key.target);
const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,0.8);
fill.position.set(4,3.7,4);
scene.add(fill);
const backLight=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffef,0.8);
backLight.position.set(1.5,5,-4);
scene.add(backLight);

const floor=new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200,200),
  new THREE.ShadowMaterial({color:0x666451,opacity:0.15})
);
floor.name='soft-shadow-ground';
floor.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;
floor.position.y=-0.66;
floor.receiveShadow=true;
scene.add(floor);

let seed=572913;
function random(){
  seed^=seed<<13;
  seed^=seed>>>17;
  seed^=seed<<5;
  return (seed>>>0)/4294967296;
}
const noiseData=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<64;x++){
  const i=(y*64+x)*4,n=120+Math.floor(random()*35);
  noiseData[i]=noiseData[i+1]=noiseData[i+2]=n;
  noiseData[i+3]=255;
}
const grain=new THREE.DataTexture(noiseData,64,64,THREE.RGBAFormat);
grain.wrapS=grain.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
grain.repeat.set(7,7);
grain.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
grain.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
grain.generateMipmaps=true;
grain.needsUpdate=true;

function skin(color,bump=0.009){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,roughness:0.98,metalness:0,bumpMap:grain,bumpScale:bump
  });
}
const gold=skin(0xdfad28);
const headTopColor=new THREE.Color(0xe7c94d);
const headGold=skin(0xffffff,0.006);
headGold.vertexColors=true;
const bellyMat=skin(0xbb9575,0.008);
const handMat=skin(0x4a4839,0.005);
const knuckleMat=skin(0x4e4b3c,0.004);
const lipMat=skin(0x986b29,0.004);
const lowerLipMat=skin(0xd1b473,0.003);
const eyeMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x352719,roughness:1});
const creaseMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xae852b,roughness:1});
const toothMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:0xfff0d6,roughness:0.9,
  emissive:0x6b5e42,emissiveIntensity:0.35
});
const tongueMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x28190f,roughness:1});
const furMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:0xffffff,vertexColors:true,roughness:1,side:THREE.FrontSide
});
const cavityMat=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide
});

const character=new THREE.Group();
character.name='laughing-yellow-character';
scene.add(character);

const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
function group(name,parent,position){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  if(position)g.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function mesh(geometry,material,parent,name){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);
  m.name=name;
  m.castShadow=material!==furMat&&material!==toothMat&&material!==cavityMat;
  m.receiveShadow=material!==furMat&&material!==toothMat;
  m.frustumCulled=false;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
const sphereGeometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32);
function ellipsoid(parent,name,position,scale,material){
  const m=mesh(sphereGeometry,material,parent,name);
  m.position.set(...position);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  return m;
}
function cubic(a,b,c,d,t){
  return b+0.5*t*(c-a+t*(2*a-5*b+4*c-d+t*(3*(b-c)+d-a)));
}
function interpolate(values,t){
  const u=THREE.MathUtils.clamp(t,0,1)*(values.length-1);
  const i=Math.min(values.length-2,Math.floor(u)),f=u-i;
  return cubic(values[Math.max(0,i-1)],values[i],values[i+1],
    values[Math.min(values.length-1,i+2)],f);
}
function closeSeamNormals(geometry,rows,columns){
  const n=geometry.attributes.normal;
  for(let j=0;j<rows;j++){
    const a=j*(columns+1),b=a+columns;
    const v=V(n.getX(a)+n.getX(b),n.getY(a)+n.getY(b),n.getZ(a)+n.getZ(b)).normalize();
    n.setXYZ(a,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    n.setXYZ(b,v.x,v.y,v.z);
  }
  n.needsUpdate=true;
}
function replaceGeometry(m,g){
  m.geometry.dispose();
  m.geometry=g;
}
function pathGeometry(points,radius,closed=false,segments=64){
  return new THREE.TubeGeometry(
    new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points,closed,'catmullrom',0.35),
    segments,radius,8,closed
  );
}
function pathMesh(parent,name,points,radius,material,closed=false,segments=64){
  return mesh(pathGeometry(points,radius,closed,segments),material,parent,name);
}
function headTint(y){
  const u=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,-0.55,0.56);
  return gold.color.clone().lerp(headTopColor,u);
}

const bodyProfile=[
  [0.64,0.025,0.025,0.04,-0.03],
  [0.76,0.44,0.33,0.03,-0.015],
  [0.97,0.67,0.47,0.01,0.005],
  [1.30,0.81,0.59,-0.015,0.02],
  [1.70,0.87,0.64,-0.04,0.005],
  [2.09,0.85,0.59,-0.055,-0.015],
  [2.45,0.84,0.53,-0.06,-0.025],
  [2.77,0.86,0.48,-0.06,-0.055],
  [3.02,0.78,0.43,-0.04,-0.075],
  [3.23,0.58,0.35,-0.015,-0.06],
  [3.43,0.31,0.26,0,-0.05],
  [3.54,0.015,0.025,0,-0.05]
];
function profile(y){
  y=THREE.MathUtils.clamp(y,bodyProfile[0][0],bodyProfile.at(-1)[0]);
  let i=0;
  while(i<bodyProfile.length-2&&y>bodyProfile[i+1][0])i++;
  const t=(y-bodyProfile[i][0])/(bodyProfile[i+1][0]-bodyProfile[i][0]);
  const out=[];
  for(let k=1;k<5;k++){
    out.push(cubic(
      bodyProfile[Math.max(0,i-1)][k],bodyProfile[i][k],
      bodyProfile[i+1][k],bodyProfile[Math.min(bodyProfile.length-1,i+2)][k],t
    ));
  }
  out[0]=Math.max(0.012,out[0]);
  out[1]=Math.max(0.012,out[1]);
  return out;
}
function bodyPoint(y,a){
  const [rx,rz,cx,cz]=profile(y);
  return V(cx+rx*Math.sin(a),y,cz+rz*Math.cos(a));
}
function bodyNormal(y,a){
  const p=profile(y),p0=profile(y-0.002),p1=profile(y+0.002);
  const da=V(p[0]*Math.cos(a),0,-p[1]*Math.sin(a));
  const dy=V(
    (p1[2]-p0[2]+(p1[0]-p0[0])*Math.sin(a))/0.004,
    1,
    (p1[3]-p0[3]+(p1[1]-p0[1])*Math.cos(a))/0.004
  );
  return da.cross(dy).normalize();
}
const torso=group('torso',character);
{
  const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[],rows=80,cols=96;
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    const y=0.64+(3.54-0.64)*j/rows;
    for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){
      const p=bodyPoint(y,2*Math.PI*i/cols);
      pos.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      uv.push(i/cols,j/rows);
      if(j<rows&&i<cols){
        const a=j*(cols+1)+i,b=a+1,c=a+cols+1,d=c+1;
        idx.push(a,b,c,b,d,c);
      }
    }
  }
  const bottom=pos.length/3;
  pos.push(0.04,0.64,-0.03);
  uv.push(0.5,0);
  const top=pos.length/3;
  pos.push(0,3.54,-0.05);
  uv.push(0.5,1);
  for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
    idx.push(bottom,i+1,i);
    const a=rows*(cols+1)+i;
    idx.push(top,a,a+1);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  closeSeamNormals(geo,rows+1,cols);
  mesh(geo,gold,torso,'rounded-golden-body');
}
const bellyCenterY=1.65,bellyRadiusY=0.66,bellyRadiusX=0.70;
function patchCenter(y){return -0.10-0.075*(y-bellyCenterY)/bellyRadiusY;}
function patchContains(x,y){
  return ((x-patchCenter(y))/bellyRadiusX)**2+
    ((y-bellyCenterY)/bellyRadiusY)**2<1;
}
function frontBodyZ(x,y){
  const [rx,rz,cx,cz]=profile(y);
  return cz+rz*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-((x-cx)/rx)**2));
}
const belly=group('belly',torso);
{
  const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[],rings=30,cols=96;
  const centerX=patchCenter(bellyCenterY);
  pos.push(centerX,bellyCenterY,frontBodyZ(centerX,bellyCenterY)+0.011);
  uv.push(0.5,0.5);
  for(let j=1;j<=rings;j++){
    const r=j/rings;
    for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/cols;
      const y=bellyCenterY+bellyRadiusY*r*Math.sin(a);
      const x=patchCenter(y)+bellyRadiusX*r*Math.cos(a)*(1-0.06*Math.sin(a));
      pos.push(x,y,frontBodyZ(x,y)+0.011);
      uv.push(0.5+(x+0.1)/1.4,0.5+(y-bellyCenterY)/1.4);
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<cols;i++)idx.push(0,1+i,1+(i+1)%cols);
  for(let j=0;j<rings-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
    const a=1+j*cols+i,b=1+j*cols+(i+1)%cols,c=a+cols,d=b+cols;
    idx.push(a,c,d,a,d,b);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const patch=mesh(geo,bellyMat,belly,'soft-tan-belly-patch');
  patch.castShadow=false;
}

function addFur(parent,name,count,sampler,baseColor){
  const positions=[],normals=[],colors=[];
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const sample=sampler();
    if(!sample)continue;
    const p=sample.p,n=sample.n.normalize();
    const color=(sample.color||baseColor).clone().multiplyScalar(0.97+random()*0.06);
    let tangent=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(
      n,Math.abs(n.y)<0.9?V(0,1,0):V(1,0,0)
    ).normalize();
    const bitangent=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n,tangent).normalize();
    const a=random()*Math.PI*2;
    tangent.multiplyScalar(Math.cos(a)).addScaledVector(bitangent,Math.sin(a)).normalize();
    const cross=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n,tangent).normalize();
    const length=0.007+random()*0.012,width=0.0013+random()*0.0011;
    const base=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,-0.002);
    const tip=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,length).addScaledVector(tangent,(random()-0.5)*0.005);
    for(const direction of [tangent,cross]){
      const a=base.clone().addScaledVector(direction,-width);
      const b=base.clone().addScaledVector(direction,width);
      for(const v of [a,b,tip,b,a,tip]){
        positions.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
        normals.push(n.x,n.y,n.z);
        colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  mesh(geo,furMat,parent,name);
}
addFur(torso,'short-body-fuzz',2600,()=>{
  const y=0.77+random()*2.68,a=random()*Math.PI*2,p=bodyPoint(y,a);
  const isPatch=Math.cos(a)>0&&patchContains(p.x,p.y);
  if(isPatch)p.z=frontBodyZ(p.x,p.y)+0.011;
  return {p,n:bodyNormal(y,a),color:isPatch?bellyMat.color:gold.color};
},gold.color);

function tubeFrame(curve,t){
  const tangent=curve.getTangent(t).normalize();
  let a=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent,V(0,0,1));
  if(a.lengthSq()<0.0001)a.crossVectors(tangent,V(1,0,0));
  a.normalize();
  const b=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent,a).normalize();
  return {a,b,tangent};
}
function tubeGeometry(curve,radii,t0,t1,origin,segments=44,sides=36,depth=1){
  const pos=[],uv=[],idx=[];
  const capStart=t0===0,capEnd=t1===1;
  for(let j=0;j<=segments;j++){
    const t=t0+(t1-t0)*j/segments;
    const p=curve.getPoint(t).sub(origin),r=interpolate(radii,t);
    const f=tubeFrame(curve,t);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/sides;
      const q=p.clone().addScaledVector(f.a,r*Math.cos(a))
        .addScaledVector(f.b,r*depth*Math.sin(a));
      pos.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      uv.push(i/sides,t);
      if(j<segments&&i<sides){
        const k=j*(sides+1)+i;
        idx.push(k,k+1,k+sides+1,k+1,k+sides+2,k+sides+1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(capStart){
    const cap=pos.length/3,p=curve.getPoint(t0).sub(origin);
    pos.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
    uv.push(0.5,t0);
    for(let i=0;i<sides;i++)idx.push(cap,i+1,i);
  }
  if(capEnd){
    const cap=pos.length/3,p=curve.getPoint(t1).sub(origin);
    pos.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
    uv.push(0.5,t1);
    for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
      const a=segments*(sides+1)+i;
      idx.push(cap,a,a+1);
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  closeSeamNormals(geo,segments+1,sides);
  geo.userData={segments,sides,depth,capStart,capEnd};
  return geo;
}
function deformTube(geo,curve,radii,t0,t1,origin){
  const {segments,sides,depth,capStart,capEnd}=geo.userData;
  const pos=geo.attributes.position;
  let k=0;
  for(let j=0;j<=segments;j++){
    const t=t0+(t1-t0)*j/segments;
    const p=curve.getPoint(t).sub(origin),r=interpolate(radii,t);
    const f=tubeFrame(curve,t);
    for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/sides,c=r*Math.cos(a),s=r*depth*Math.sin(a);
      pos.setXYZ(k++,p.x+f.a.x*c+f.b.x*s,p.y+f.a.y*c+f.b.y*s,p.z+f.a.z*c+f.b.z*s);
    }
  }
  if(capStart){
    const p=curve.getPoint(t0).sub(origin);
    pos.setXYZ(k++,p.x,p.y,p.z);
  }
  if(capEnd){
    const p=curve.getPoint(t1).sub(origin);
    pos.setXYZ(k,p.x,p.y,p.z);
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=true;
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  closeSeamNormals(geo,segments+1,sides);
}
function joinLimbNormals(upper,lower){
  const a=upper.attributes.normal,b=lower.attributes.normal;
  const sides=upper.userData.sides;
  const start=upper.userData.segments*(sides+1);
  for(let i=0;i<=sides;i++){
    const v=V(
      a.getX(start+i)+b.getX(i),
      a.getY(start+i)+b.getY(i),
      a.getZ(start+i)+b.getZ(i)
    ).normalize();
    a.setXYZ(start+i,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    b.setXYZ(i,v.x,v.y,v.z);
  }
  a.needsUpdate=b.needsUpdate=true;
}
function limbFur(parent,count,curve,radii,t0,t1,origin,color){
  const samples=[],colors=[];
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    samples.push({
      t:t0+(t1-t0)*random(),a:random()*Math.PI*2,
      length:0.007+random()*0.012,width:0.0013+random()*0.0011,
      turn:random()*Math.PI*2,bend:(random()-0.5)*0.005
    });
    const c=color.clone().multiplyScalar(0.97+random()*0.06);
    for(let j=0;j<12;j++)colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count*36),3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(count*36),3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  mesh(geo,furMat,parent,'short-limb-fuzz');
  function update(){
    const positions=geo.attributes.position,normals=geo.attributes.normal;
    let index=0;
    for(const s of samples){
      const f=tubeFrame(curve,s.t);
      const n=f.a.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(s.a)).addScaledVector(f.b,Math.sin(s.a)).normalize();
      const circ=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n,f.tangent).normalize();
      const tangent=f.tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(s.turn)).addScaledVector(circ,Math.sin(s.turn)).normalize();
      const cross=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n,tangent).normalize();
      const p=curve.getPoint(s.t).sub(origin).addScaledVector(n,interpolate(radii,s.t));
      const base=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,-0.002);
      const tip=p.clone().addScaledVector(n,s.length).addScaledVector(tangent,s.bend);
      for(const direction of [tangent,cross]){
        const a=base.clone().addScaledVector(direction,-s.width);
        const b=base.clone().addScaledVector(direction,s.width);
        for(const v of [a,b,tip,b,a,tip]){
          positions.setXYZ(index,v.x,v.y,v.z);
          normals.setXYZ(index,n.x,n.y,n.z);
          index++;
        }
      }
    }
    positions.needsUpdate=true;
    normals.needsUpdate=true;
  }
  update();
  return update;
}
function makeLimb(name,points,radii,material,upperName,lowerName,furCount){
  const start=points[0].clone();
  const root=group(name,character,start);
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>p.clone().sub(start)),false,'catmullrom',0.35);
  const split=0.54,elbow=curve.getPoint(split),zero=V(0,0,0);
  const upper=group(upperName,root);
  const lower=group(lowerName,root,elbow);
  const upMesh=mesh(tubeGeometry(curve,radii,0,split,zero),material,upper,upperName+'-volume');
  const lowMesh=mesh(tubeGeometry(curve,radii,split,1,elbow),material,lower,lowerName+'-volume');
  joinLimbNormals(upMesh.geometry,lowMesh.geometry);
  const updateUpperFur=limbFur(upper,Math.floor(furCount/2),curve,radii,0,split,zero,material.color);
  const updateLowerFur=limbFur(lower,Math.floor(furCount/2),curve,radii,split,1,elbow,material.color);
  const end=curve.getPoint(1).sub(elbow);
  function pose(newPoints){
    start.copy(newPoints[0]);
    root.position.copy(start);
    for(let i=0;i<curve.points.length;i++)curve.points[i].copy(newPoints[i]).sub(start);
    elbow.copy(curve.getPoint(split));
    lower.position.copy(elbow);
    end.copy(curve.getPoint(1)).sub(elbow);
    deformTube(upMesh.geometry,curve,radii,0,split,zero);
    deformTube(lowMesh.geometry,curve,radii,split,1,elbow);
    joinLimbNormals(upMesh.geometry,lowMesh.geometry);
    updateUpperFur();
    updateLowerFur();
  }
  return {root,upper,lower,end,pose};
}

const leftLeg=makeLimb('leg-left',[
  V(-0.37,1.07,-0.025),V(-0.51,0.64,-0.005),V(-0.58,0.23,0.035),V(-0.59,-0.34,0.14)
],[0.35,0.34,0.275,0.235],gold,'thigh-left','shin-left',500);
const rightLeg=makeLimb('leg-right',[
  V(0.40,1.08,-0.045),V(0.55,0.60,-0.02),V(0.63,0.18,0.065),V(0.68,-0.34,0.14)
],[0.36,0.34,0.28,0.235],gold,'thigh-right','shin-right',500);

const feet=[];

function finger(parent,name,points,radii){
  const g=group(name,parent);
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points,false,'catmullrom',0.25);
  mesh(tubeGeometry(curve,radii,0,1,V(0,0,0),18,12),handMat,g,name+'-volume');
  const p=points.at(-1),r=radii.at(-1);

}
function makeHand(arm,side){

  const offset=side==='right'?-0.025:0;
  ellipsoid(hand,'palm',[offset,-0.17,0.015],[0.174,0.19,0.105],handMat);
  ellipsoid(hand,'wrist',[0,-0.015,-0.005],[0.135,0.13,0.105],handMat);
  const xs=[-0.135,-0.045,0.05,0.135],lengths=[0.455,0.535,0.55,0.48];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const x=xs[i]+offset,y0=-0.26+Math.abs(i-1.5)*0.018;
    const xEnd=x+(i-1.5)*0.014;
    finger(hand,'finger-'+i,[
      V(x,y0,0.055),V(x+(i-1.5)*0.009,-0.365,0.09),V(xEnd,-lengths[i],0.105)
    ],[0.05,0.043,0.033]);
    ellipsoid(hand,'knuckle-'+i,[x,y0+0.025,0.086],[0.048,0.055,0.032],knuckleMat);

    V(offset+s*0.13,-0.115,0.035),

}

const head=group('head',character,V(0.06,3.54,0.17));
const RX=0.56,RY=0.72,RZ=0.48;
const mouthX=-0.045,baseMouthY=-0.18,mouthRX=0.39,mouthRY=0.415;
let mouthY=baseMouthY,mouthOpening=1,mouthWidth=1;
function headZ(x,y){
  return RZ*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(x/RX)**2-(y/RY)**2));
}
function mouthRim(a){
  const c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);
  const x=mouthX+mouthRX*mouthWidth*Math.sign(c)*Math.pow(Math.abs(c),0.57)*(0.88+0.12*s);
  const y=mouthY+mouthRY*mouthOpening*(s>=0?Math.pow(s,0.57):s);
  return V(x,y,headZ(x,y));
}
function headSurface(front){
  const positions=[],normals=[],colors=[],uv=[],idx=[],rows=34,cols=128;
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    const u=j/rows;
    for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/cols;
      let x,y,z;
      if(front){
        const inner=mouthRim(a);
        x=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inner.x,RX*Math.cos(a),u);
        y=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inner.y,RY*Math.sin(a),u);
        z=headZ(x,y);
      }else{
        x=RX*u*Math.cos(a);
        y=RY*u*Math.sin(a);
        z=-RZ*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-u*u));
      }
      positions.push(x,y,z);
      const n=V(x/(RX*RX),y/(RY*RY),z/(RZ*RZ)).normalize();
      normals.push(n.x,n.y,n.z);
      const color=headTint(y);
      colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      uv.push(
        0.5+Math.atan2(x/RX,z/RZ)/(2*Math.PI),
        0.5+Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(y/RY,-1,1))/Math.PI
      );
      if(j<rows&&i<cols){
        const a0=j*(cols+1)+i,b=a0+cols+1,c=b+1,d=a0+1;
        if(front)idx.push(a0,b,c,a0,c,d);
        else idx.push(a0,c,b,a0,d,c);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  return geo;
}
const faceMesh=mesh(headSurface(true),headGold,head,'face-with-open-mouth');
mesh(headSurface(false),headGold,head,'rounded-back-of-head');

const mouth=group('mouth',head);
function cavityGeometry(){
  const positions=[],colors=[],idx=[],rings=30,cols=128;
  const dark=new THREE.Color(0x080503),edge=new THREE.Color(0x281a0c);
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
    const r=j/rings;
    for(let i=0;i<=cols;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/cols,p=mouthRim(a);
      const x=mouthX+(p.x-mouthX)*r,y=mouthY+(p.y-mouthY)*r;
      const z=0.065+(p.z-0.073)*Math.pow(r,1.65);
      positions.push(x,y,z);
      const tint=dark.clone().lerp(edge,Math.pow(r,4)*0.7);
      colors.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
      if(j<rings&&i<cols){
        const q=j*(cols+1)+i,b=q+cols+1;
        idx.push(q,b,b+1,q,b+1,q+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  return geo;
}
const cavity=mesh(cavityGeometry(),cavityMat,mouth,'deep-mouth-cavity');
cavity.receiveShadow=false;

function lipPoints(){
  const points=[];
  for(let i=0;i<112;i++){
    const p=mouthRim(2*Math.PI*i/112);
    p.z+=0.013;
    points.push(p);
  }
  return points;
}
const lip=pathMesh(mouth,'golden-mouth-rim',lipPoints(),0.024,lipMat,true,112);
const jaw=group('lower-jaw',mouth);
function lowerLipPoints(){
  const points=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=48;i++){
    const p=mouthRim(Math.PI+0.12+(Math.PI-0.24)*i/48);
    p.z+=0.032;
    points.push(p);
  }
  return points;
}
const innerLip=pathMesh(jaw,'pale-inner-lower-lip',lowerLipPoints(),0.013,lowerLipMat,false,60);
const upperTeeth=group('upper-teeth',mouth);
function toothGeometry(a0,a1){
  const a=mouthRim(a0),b=mouthRim(a1);
  a.z+=0.025;
  b.z+=0.025;
  const mid=(a0+a1)*0.5;
  const h=0.083*(0.9+0.1*mouthOpening)*(1+0.12*Math.sin(mid));
  const p=[
    a.x,a.y-0.005,a.z,b.x,b.y-0.005,b.z,
    b.x,b.y-h,b.z+0.017,a.x,a.y-h,a.z+0.017,
    a.x,a.y-0.005,a.z-0.045,b.x,b.y-0.005,b.z-0.045,
    b.x,b.y-h,b.z-0.028,a.x,a.y-h,a.z-0.028
  ];
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
  g.setIndex([
    0,1,2,0,2,3,4,6,5,4,7,6,
    0,4,5,0,5,1,3,2,6,3,6,7,
    0,3,7,0,7,4,1,5,6,1,6,2
  ]);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
const teethStart=0.78,teethEnd=Math.PI-0.78,toothMeshes=[];
for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
  const a0=teethStart+(teethEnd-teethStart)*i/8+0.006;
  const a1=teethStart+(teethEnd-teethStart)*(i+1)/8-0.006;
  toothMeshes.push({
    a0,a1,
    mesh:mesh(toothGeometry(a0,a1),toothMat,upperTeeth,'upper-tooth-'+i)
  });
}
const tongue=ellipsoid(mouth,'low-dark-tongue',[-0.035,-0.485,0.205],[0.12,0.035,0.043],tongueMat);
tongue.castShadow=false;
const lowerTeeth=group('lower-teeth',jaw);
function lowerTeethPoints(){

const toothCrescent=pathMesh(lowerTeeth,'little-lower-teeth-crescent',lowerTeethPoints(),0.014,toothMat,false,32);
const littleTooth=ellipsoid(lowerTeeth,'left-lower-tooth',[-0.207,-0.478,0.329],[0.025,0.049,0.024],toothMat);
littleTooth.rotation.z=0.30;

const eyes=group('eyes',head);
function closedEye(name,cx,y0,width,arch){
  const eye=group(name,eyes),points=[],crease=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=16;i++){
    const t=-1+2*i/16,x=cx+width*t,y=y0+arch*(1-t*t);

    const y2=y-0.025;
    crease.push(V(x,y2,headZ(x,y2)+0.006));
  }
  pathMesh(eye,'soft-lower-eyelid-fold',crease,0.007,creaseMat,false,30);
  pathMesh(eye,'closed-laughing-eye',points,0.018,eyeMat,false,36);
}
closedEye('eye-left',-0.34,0.40,0.105,0.060);
closedEye('eye-right',0.29,0.38,0.098,0.055);

function insideMouth(x,y){
  const dy=(y-baseMouthY)/mouthRY;
  if(dy<=-1||dy>=1)return false;
  const s=dy>=0?Math.pow(dy,1/0.57):dy;
  const c=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-s*s));
  const w=mouthRX*Math.pow(c,0.57)*(0.88+0.12*s);
  return Math.abs(x-mouthX)<w+0.026;
}
addFur(head,'fine-head-fuzz',1350,()=>{
  const y=-1+2*random(),a=2*Math.PI*random(),r=Math.sqrt(1-y*y);
  const p=V(RX*r*Math.cos(a),RY*y,RZ*r*Math.sin(a));
  if(p.z>0&&insideMouth(p.x,p.y))return null;
  return {
    p,n:V(p.x/(RX*RX),p.y/(RY*RY),p.z/(RZ*RZ)).normalize(),
    color:headTint(p.y)
  };
},headTopColor);

let lastOpening=1,lastWidth=1;
function poseMouth(opening,width){
  if(opening===lastOpening&&width===lastWidth)return;
  mouthOpening=opening;
  mouthWidth=width;
  mouthY=baseMouthY+0.32*(1-opening);
  replaceGeometry(faceMesh,headSurface(true));
  replaceGeometry(cavity,cavityGeometry());
  replaceGeometry(lip,pathGeometry(lipPoints(),0.024,true,112));
  replaceGeometry(innerLip,pathGeometry(lowerLipPoints(),0.013,false,60));
  for(const tooth of toothMeshes){
    replaceGeometry(tooth.mesh,toothGeometry(tooth.a0,tooth.a1));
  }
  replaceGeometry(toothCrescent,pathGeometry(lowerTeethPoints(),0.014,false,32));
  const tx=mouthX+(-0.035-mouthX)*width;
  const ty=mouthY+(-0.485-baseMouthY)*opening;
  tongue.position.set(tx,ty,0.205+headZ(tx,ty)-headZ(-0.035,-0.485));
  tongue.scale.set(0.12*width,0.035*opening,0.043);
  const lx=mouthX+(-0.207-mouthX)*width;
  const ly=mouthY+(-0.478-baseMouthY)*opening;
  littleTooth.position.set(lx,ly,0.329+headZ(lx,ly)-headZ(-0.207,-0.478));
  littleTooth.scale.set(0.025,0.049*(0.85+0.15*opening),0.024);
  lastOpening=opening;
  lastWidth=width;
}

const poseKeys=[
  {t:0,c:0,sy:1,drop:0,pitch:0,roll:0,hx:0,lift:0,rx:-0.10,ry:0,rz:-0.22,open:1,width:1,yaw:-0.10},
  {t:180,c:1,sy:0.78,drop:-0.30,pitch:0.12,roll:0.025,hx:-0.02,lift:0,rx:0.035,ry:-0.03,rz:-0.04,open:0.63,width:1.03,yaw:-0.08},
  {t:340,c:0,sy:1,drop:0,pitch:0,roll:0,hx:0,lift:0.10,rx:-0.85,ry:0.01,rz:0.015,open:1.02,width:0.99,yaw:-0.06},
  {t:520,c:0.04,sy:0.995,drop:-0.015,pitch:0.01,roll:0.08,hx:-0.28,lift:-0.005,rx:-0.10,ry:-0.35,rz:0.32,open:1,width:1.02,yaw:-0.10},
  {t:680,c:1,sy:0.73,drop:-0.31,pitch:0.18,roll:0.10,hx:-0.25,lift:-0.08,rx:0.02,ry:-0.42,rz:0.34,open:0.67,width:1.04,yaw:-0.12},
  {t:860,c:0,sy:1,drop:-0.05,pitch:-0.01,roll:0.03,hx:-0.12,lift:0.02,rx:-0.91,ry:-0.08,rz:0.10,open:1,width:1,yaw:-0.08},
  {t:1020,c:0.10,sy:0.97,drop:-0.10,pitch:0.04,roll:0.10,hx:-0.25,lift:-0.02,rx:-0.05,ry:-0.25,rz:0.22,open:0.94,width:1.01,yaw:-0.10},
  {t:1200,c:1,sy:0.74,drop:-0.30,pitch:0.17,roll:0.10,hx:-0.48,lift:-0.02,rx:0.05,ry:-0.53,rz:0.38,open:0.66,width:1.04,yaw:-0.11}
];
poseKeys.push({...poseKeys[0],t:1220});
const poseProperties=Object.keys(poseKeys[0]).filter(k=>k!=='t');
function samplePose(t){
  const phase=((t%1220)+1220)%1220;
  let i=0;
  while(i<poseKeys.length-2&&phase>=poseKeys[i+1].t)i++;
  const a=poseKeys[i],b=poseKeys[i+1];
  const u=(phase-a.t)/(b.t-a.t);
  const s=u*u*(3-2*u),p={};
  for(const k of poseProperties)p[k]=a[k]+(b[k]-a[k])*s;
  return p;
}
const headBase=V(0.06,3.54,0.17);
const headLocalRotation=new THREE.Quaternion();
const headEuler=new THREE.Euler();
function blendPoint(a,b,u){return a.clone().lerp(b,u);}
function poseArms(p){
  const c=p.c,sway=p.hx*0.12;
  const sl=leftArmRest[0].clone().applyMatrix4(torso.matrix);
  const sr=rightArmRest[0].clone().applyMatrix4(torso.matrix);
  const dl=sl.clone().sub(leftArmRest[0]),dr=sr.clone().sub(rightArmRest[0]);
  const follow=[1,0.9,0.7,0.4,0.2,0];
  const lRest=leftArmRest.map((v,i)=>v.clone().addScaledVector(dl,follow[i]));
  const rRest=rightArmRest.map((v,i)=>v.clone().addScaledVector(dr,follow[i]));
  const lSquat=[
    sl,sl.clone().add(V(-0.27,-0.24,0.02)),
    V(-1.17+sway,1.58,0.18),V(-1.18+sway,1.36,0.28),
    V(-1.05+sway,1.04,0.48),V(-0.94+sway,0.89,0.54)
  ];
  const rSquat=[
    sr,sr.clone().add(V(0.39,-0.20,0.02)),
    V(1.37+sway,1.67,0.13),V(1.40+sway,1.40,0.25),
    V(1.06+sway,1.04,0.48),V(0.82+sway,0.85,0.58)
  ];
  leftArm.pose(lRest.map((v,i)=>blendPoint(v,lSquat[i],c)));
  rightArm.pose(rRest.map((v,i)=>blendPoint(v,rSquat[i],c)));
  leftHand.position.copy(leftArm.end);
  rightHand.position.copy(rightArm.end);
  leftHand.position.y+=0.02*(1-c);
  rightHand.position.y+=0.02*(1-c);
  leftHand.scale.set(1,0.88+0.12*c,1);
  rightHand.scale.set(1,0.88+0.12*c,1);
  leftHand.rotation.set(-0.07+0.10*c,0,-0.035-0.10*c);
  rightHand.rotation.set(-0.07+0.10*c,0,0.09+0.02*c);
}
function poseLegs(p){
  const c=p.c;
  leftLeg.pose([
    V(-0.37,1.07,-0.025).applyMatrix4(torso.matrix),
    blendPoint(V(-0.51,0.64,-0.005),V(-0.79,0.40,0.22),c),
    blendPoint(V(-0.58,0.23,0.035),V(-0.89,0.04,0.34),c),
    V(-0.59-0.21*c,-0.34,0.14+0.05*c)
  ]);
  rightLeg.pose([
    V(0.40,1.08,-0.045).applyMatrix4(torso.matrix),
    blendPoint(V(0.55,0.60,-0.02),V(0.77,0.37,0.18),c),
    blendPoint(V(0.63,0.18,0.065),V(0.94,0.03,0.33),c),
    V(0.68+0.21*c,-0.34,0.14+0.05*c)
  ]);
  for(const {leg,foot}of feet)foot.position.copy(leg.end);
}
function render(t){
  const p=samplePose(Number.isFinite(t)?t:0);
  character.rotation.set(0,p.yaw,0);

  torso.scale.set(1+0.07*p.c,p.sy,1+0.05*p.c);
  torso.rotation.set(p.pitch,0,p.roll);
  const scaledPivot=V(0,p.sy,0).applyQuaternion(torso.quaternion);
  torso.position.set(-scaledPivot.x,1+p.drop-scaledPivot.y,-scaledPivot.z);
  torso.updateMatrix();

  head.position.copy(headBase).applyMatrix4(torso.matrix);
  head.position.x+=p.hx;
  head.position.y+=p.lift;
  headEuler.set(p.rx,p.ry,p.rz,'XYZ');
  headLocalRotation.setFromEuler(headEuler);
  head.quaternion.copy(torso.quaternion).multiply(headLocalRotation);
  head.scale.set(1,1-0.08*p.c,1);
  poseMouth(p.open,p.width);
  poseArms(p);
  poseLegs(p);

  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.setViewport(0,0,216,216);
  renderer.setScissorTest(false);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
const characters=[character];
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:false};
render(0);
window.nwb.ready=true;
</script>
